worker._rest_note: rest_near_entrance: a worker with nothing to do goes inside and rests within this many blocks of the entrance (real Pogonomyrmex keep their spare workers in the upper chambers by the entrance, ready to go out; they do not stroll about outside). 0: they stroll about anywhere. User's decision 2026-10-15; the 8 blocks are my pick, to confirm.

day_clock._note: The foragers' daily round (brain step 4b; real Pogonomyrmex forage in the morning, stop when the ground gets too hot at midday, go out again in the afternoon, and stay in at night and in the rain). Times are Minecraft day times: 0 is sunrise (6:00), 1000 ticks an hour. Out from out_from to in_by, except a midday rest centred on rest_middle; the rest goes by the biome's heat (base temperature): none at rest_from_heat or cooler, rest_most ticks at rest_full_heat or hotter (plains 0.8: about 50 minutes; badlands 2.0: 4 hours). not_in_rain: in while rain falls on the nest. User's decisions: rest by biome heat, never at night or in rain; the times are my picks, to confirm.

trails._note: Lasting trunk trails (brain step 4a; real Pogonomyrmex keep a few cleared paths straight out from the nest disc, the foragers walk out along one and fan out at its end). half_life_ticks: a trail's strength halves in that long unused (each trip adds 1, at most most_strength); below fade_below it is forgotten and its bare ground grows back to grass about regrow_ticks later (half to one and a half times that). trunk: trails run from start blocks out (the hill's edge) to the food radius; a colony keeps 1 trail while young and up to most at full_at_workers workers; a trip goes by the trail within spread_degrees of its food's direction; new_trail_trips trips in a direction with no trail (within a day) lay a new one; a block walked by bare_after_trips trips wears bare: its plant is cut and the ground turns to bare_ground. All numbers are my picks, to confirm.

door._note: How many foragers go out (brain step 4b, Deborah Gordon's rule; real Pogonomyrmex barbatus): no ant is in charge. Foragers not out wait inside by the entrance; a forager home with a seed (or a patroller home from its round) touches the waiting ants it passes within touch_reach blocks; one touched touches_needed times within touch_memory_ticks goes out (Greene and Gordon: about one contact every 10 seconds). Empty returns do not count. Under small_colony_foragers foragers one touch is enough, a homecomer reaches every waiting ant by the entrance, and a forager's own seed counts as its touch (the user: young colonies must not be slowed). For the forager numbers each homecomer touches touches_per_return waiting ones. User's decisions: real touches at the real ants' pace; the numbers are my picks, to confirm.

patrol._note: Patrollers (brain step 4b; real Pogonomyrmex barbatus, Gordon, Greene and Gordon 2007): each time the day clock opens (dawn, after the midday rest, after rain) workers taken from the builders go out first, over and round the hill and then reach blocks out along a trunk trail (or a new direction) and back. Foraging starts only once one is back, and only in the directions they came back from; with none back, none that round. Dawn patrol: share of the workers (the user's scaling: 2 at 10, 4 at 25, 8 at 50, 16 at 100), at least least; later rounds later_rounds of that (the user's: half). A patroller hurt or with a hostile mob within hostile_within blocks turns back: its direction shut for the day, extra_on_danger times as many again patrol the hill, foragers allowed out foragers_after_danger of the share for the rest of the day. Another colony's ants met: that direction shut for the day. reach, hostile_within, extra_on_danger and foragers_after_danger are my picks, to confirm.

body_language._note: How the bodies behave (the animation engine, 2026-10-16; every number my pick, to confirm). naps: real ants sleep in many short naps (Cassill et al. 2009, fire ants: workers about 250 a day of about a minute, queens about 90 of about 6 minutes; nothing measured for Pogonomyrmex yet). A worker with nothing to do inside the nest falls asleep with chance_per_second each second; a nap lasts worker_ticks (from, to), a queen's queen_ticks. hot: on ground too hot to touch they stand and walk tall with the gaster up; outside under the open sky in a biome at least from_heat hot (base temperature: badlands, desert and savanna 2.0, plains 0.8), from around_rest_ticks before the midday rest until as long after it.
